numpy.ndarray.data.notes: Returns np.MemoryView, NumSharp's analog of the memoryview (tobytes, hex, shape, strides, format, readonly and the contiguity flags are gated by surface.jsonl); the Python buffer protocol itself (cast, release, slicing) has no C# counterpart.

numpy.complex64.notes: A scalar class (NDScalarType, also np.csingle): the hierarchy, np.issubdtype / np.isdtype / np.finfo / isinstance / issubclass work, but NumSharp has no complex64 storage dtype, so np.dtype(np.complex64) raises NotSupportedException.

numpy.csingle.notes: NumPy's other name for numpy.complex64, the same NDScalarType: the type tests work, but NumSharp has no complex64 storage dtype, so np.dtype(np.csingle) raises NotSupportedException.

numpy.object_.notes: A scalar class (NDScalarType): the hierarchy and the type tests work, but NumSharp has no object dtype, so np.dtype(np.object_) raises NotSupportedException.

numpy.void.notes: A scalar class (NDScalarType): the hierarchy and the type tests work, but NumSharp has no void or structured dtype, so np.dtype(np.void) raises NotSupportedException.
